entities.summary: Bina Nusantara University, also known as BINUS UNIVERSITY, is a private university in Indonesia. The main campus of the university is located in Kebon Jeruk, West Jakarta. Most of its campuses are located within the area of Greater Jakarta Region. It also has campuses at Bandung, Malang, Bekasi, and Semarang. Bina Nusantara University is a university in Asia, established in 1996. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
